requested_sources.title: AES EEG Textbook and Atlas
requested_sources.description: Free 2016 American Epilepsy Society textbook edited by Erik K. St. Louis, MD and Lauren C. Frey, MD. Normal and abnormal EEG, developmental patterns, artifacts and technical principles. Pair older clinical material with current guidelines. No CEU credit established.

requested_sources.title: IFCN Masterclass Recordings
requested_sources.description: Complimentary expert lectures in EEG, quantitative EEG, neonatal epilepsy and clinical neurophysiology. Free website registration and login are required for older recordings. EEG technologist CEU credit has not been verified.

requested_sources.title: Neurocritical Care Society Learning Center
requested_sources.description: Society courses, clinical references and learning tools for neurological emergencies and ICU care. Access varies by product: some resources are free, others require payment or membership. Check the individual activity for credit eligibility.

requested_sources.title: NCS Brain Death Determination Toolkit
requested_sources.description: Free educational toolkit based on the 2023 multidisciplinary brain death guideline, with clinical tools and FAQs. Registration required. Separate certification courses are paid. No EEG technologist CEU credit established; use current institutional policies.

requested_sources.title: ASNM Position Statements and Literature
requested_sources.description: Official society index of EEG, SSEP, MEP, auditory response and professional practice references supporting CNIM study. Index is public; access and publication dates vary by document. Reading these references does not independently award CEUs.

requested_sources.title: ICNA International Child Neurology Teaching Network
requested_sources.description: Expert pediatric neurology webinars and modular learning covering epilepsy, neonatal neurology and neurophysiology. Certificate courses require a paid subscription; check individual webinar access. These are child neurology resources, not an ABRET exam preparation program. EEG technologist CEU eligibility is unverified.
